sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.product_id,SUM(p.picked) total_picked,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inv i WHERE i.product_id=p.product_id) available,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM dem d WHERE d.product_id=p.product_id) required,MAX(p.picked>p.demand_qty OR p.picked>p.inventory_qty) over_single FROM picks p GROUP BY p.product_id
